template.norm: unit L2 norm with filtration integration and division by 15 layers
template.training: equal-weight mean of unit H0 tangents from older clean OBC L16 and L64 directed cuts; every L32 cut held out

frozen_algorithm.derivative: forward finite difference between adjacent Gamma points; response assigned to interval midpoint
frozen_algorithm.signed_velocity: L2 inner product of the landscape derivative with the frozen u_clean
frozen_algorithm.unsigned_velocity: L2 norm of the same landscape derivative
frozen_algorithm.physical_response: negative forward finite difference of bulk_ms2
frozen_algorithm.qc_invalid_interval: either endpoint has branch_disagreement or selected_max_bond_dimension >= chi
frozen_algorithm.per_seed_detector: discrete maximum positive signed velocity among QC-valid intervals
frozen_algorithm.aggregate_qc_curve: at each interval, mean the derivative over QC-valid seeds only
frozen_algorithm.aggregate_detector: discrete maximum positive signed velocity over intervals meeting the valid-seed threshold
frozen_algorithm.reference: exact thermodynamic critical Gamma0=1; used only after all detector positions are computed

outputs_to_compare: aggregate peak of signed H0 velocity
aggregate peak of unsigned H0 speed
aggregate peak of physical bulk response
interpretation_guardrails: These random datasets pre-exist and have been analyzed with other observables, so this is a frozen reanalysis, not a virgin-data confirmatory experiment.
No template, sign, filtration grid, layer count, QC rule, seed subset or search window may be changed after inspecting signed random results.
L, chi and campaign provenance remain separate; no scan is counted twice.
No output is written to paper_figures in this exploratory pass.
